rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Thin-File Identity Clustering")`
`comment("Detects 3+ thin-file applicants sharing address, phone, or device")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:account_onboarding
  credit_history_months<12 tradeline_count<3
| stats dc(applicant_id) AS applicant_count,
        values(applicant_id) AS applicants,
        values(phone) AS phones,
        values(device_fingerprint) AS devices,
        values(ssn_hash) AS ssn_hashes,
        min(application_date) AS first_app,
        max(application_date) AS last_app
  BY address
| where applicant_count >= 3
| eval days_span = round((strptime(last_app, "%Y-%m-%d") - strptime(first_app, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400)
| where days_span <= 180
| eval shared_attribute = "address"
| table address, applicant_count, applicants, phones, devices,
        ssn_hashes, first_app, last_app, days_span
| sort - applicant_count
rules.title: DL-0152: Thin-File Identity Clustering — Shared Address, Phone, or Device Across New Applicants (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for SSN Age and Issuance Mismatch")`
`comment("Detects synthetic identity via SSN-DOB-credit file inconsistencies")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:account_onboarding
  event_type="CREDIT_APPLICATION"
| eval ssn_dob_gap = ssn_issue_year_estimated - applicant_birth_year
| eval risk_indicator = case(
    applicant_stated_age > 25 AND credit_file_age_months < 18, "late_credit_file",
    ssn_issue_year_estimated > applicant_birth_year, "ssn_postdates_birth",
    applicant_stated_age < 16 AND credit_inquiry_exists="true", "minor_ssn_with_credit",
    1=1, "none")
| where risk_indicator != "none"
| table applicant_id, application_date, applicant_stated_age,
        credit_file_age_months, ssn_issue_year_estimated,
        applicant_birth_year, ssn_dob_gap,
        risk_indicator, address, device_fingerprint
| sort - application_date
rules.title: DL-0154: SSN Age and Issuance Mismatch — Synthetic Identity Indicator (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for AI-Generated ID Document Detection")`
`comment("Detects document submissions with metadata indicating AI generation")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
  event_type="DOCUMENT_SUBMISSION"
| eval anomaly_type = case(
    document_ai_score > 0.7, "high_ai_score",
    match(pdf_creator, "Photoshop|GIMP|Stable Diffusion|Midjourney|DALL-E|unknown_ai_generator")
      AND exif_data_present="false", "suspicious_creator_no_exif",
    pdf_creation_date > pdf_modification_date, "timestamp_manipulation",
    dpi_consistency_check="false", "dpi_inconsistency",
    font_embedding_anomaly="true", "font_anomaly",
    1=1, "none")
| where anomaly_type != "none"
| table applicant_id, submission_timestamp, document_type,
        document_ai_score, pdf_creator, exif_data_present,
        dpi_consistency_check, font_embedding_anomaly,
        anomaly_type, device_fingerprint, ip_address
| sort - submission_timestamp
rules.title: DL-0158: Document Metadata Anomaly — AI-Generated ID Document Detection (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Iterative Deepfake Tuning Detection")`
`comment("Detects repeated liveness failures followed by success from same device")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
  event_type="LIVENESS_CHECK"
| sort 0 device_fingerprint, liveness_timestamp
| eventstats
    count(if(liveness_result="fail", 1, NULL)) as failure_count,
    count(if(liveness_result="pass", 1, NULL)) as success_count,
    min(liveness_timestamp) as first_attempt,
    max(liveness_timestamp) as last_attempt
    by device_fingerprint
| where (last_attempt - first_attempt) <= 86400
    AND failure_count >= 3 AND success_count >= 1
| streamstats current=t window=0 values(liveness_score) as score_history
    by device_fingerprint
| dedup device_fingerprint
| table device_fingerprint, failure_count, success_count,
        score_history, first_attempt, last_attempt
| sort - failure_count
rules.title: DL-0159: Facial Liveness Failure Pattern — Iterative Deepfake Tuning (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Cross-Application Identity Collision Detection")`
`comment("Detects same biometric or device across different identity applications")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
  event_type="CREDIT_APPLICATION"
  earliest=-90d@d
| stats
    dc(applicant_name) as distinct_names,
    dc(ssn_hash) as distinct_ssns,
    values(applicant_id) as applicant_ids,
    values(applicant_name) as names,
    values(ssn_hash) as ssn_hashes,
    values(application_date) as application_dates
    by face_embedding_hash
| where distinct_names >= 2 OR distinct_ssns >= 2
| eval identity_collision_type = "biometric_collision"
| append [
    search index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
      event_type="CREDIT_APPLICATION"
      earliest=-90d@d
    | stats
        dc(applicant_name) as distinct_names,
        dc(ssn_hash) as distinct_ssns,
        values(applicant_id) as applicant_ids,
        values(applicant_name) as names,
        values(ssn_hash) as ssn_hashes,
        values(application_date) as application_dates
        by device_fingerprint
    | where distinct_names >= 2 OR distinct_ssns >= 2
    | eval identity_collision_type = "device_collision"
  ]
| sort - distinct_names
rules.title: DL-0160: Cross-Application Identity Collision — Same Biometric or Device Across Different Identities (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for AI Document Template Cluster Detection")`
`comment("Detects clusters of documents sharing AI generation template signatures")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:document_verification
  event_type="DOCUMENT_SUBMISSION"
  earliest=-90d@d
| stats
    count as cluster_size,
    dc(applicant_name) as distinct_applicants,
    dc(ssn_hash) as distinct_ssns,
    avg(template_similarity_score) as avg_similarity,
    values(applicant_id) as applicant_ids,
    values(applicant_name) as names,
    values(document_type) as document_types,
    min(submission_timestamp) as cluster_start,
    max(submission_timestamp) as cluster_end
    by template_cluster_id
| where cluster_size >= 3 AND distinct_applicants >= 3 AND avg_similarity > 0.85
| eval cluster_time_span_days = round((cluster_end - cluster_start) / 86400, 1)
| table template_cluster_id, cluster_size, distinct_applicants,
        distinct_ssns, avg_similarity, cluster_start, cluster_end,
        cluster_time_span_days, applicant_ids, names, document_types
| sort - cluster_size
rules.title: DL-0161: AI Document Template Cluster — Identical Formatting Patterns Across Applications (SPLUNK)
